question:
I have a simple dbt macro function

{% macro test_func(
  arg1="col1",
  arg2=list_of_values
) %}
{{ log("Arg1:" ~ arg1, True) }}
{{ log("Arg2:" ~ arg2, True) }}
{{ log("data type of Arg2:" ~ type(arg2), True)}}

{% endmacro %}

Basically i wanted to use type(arg2) to check the data type of that argument?
title: how to check the data type of dbt macro function argument?
answer:
The answer relies purely on Jinja2 syntax.

You can test your arguments data types this way (as per the Jinja2 documentation, example if you're expecting Arg2 to be an integer):

{% macro test_func(
  arg1="col1",
  arg2=list_of_values
) %}
{{ log("Arg1:" ~ arg1, True) }}
{{ log("Arg2:" ~ arg2, True) }}
{{ log("Is Arg2 an integer: " ~ arg2 is integer, True)}}

{% endmacro %}
